gaps.sentence: The factory laid ___ two hundred workers.
gaps.explanation: lay off = dismiss workers because there is not enough work.

gaps.sentence: Several runners passed ___ in the heat.

gaps.explanation: run out OF something = have none left.

gaps.sentence: Lawyers are drawing ___ the contract now.
gaps.explanation: draw up = prepare and write (a contract, list, plan).
bring down = cause a government/person to lose power; reduce (prices).

gaps.sentence: She ___ down an offer from a rival university.
The caterpillar will turn ___ a butterfly.
The evidence finally backed ___ his version of events.
gaps.explanation: back up = support with evidence (a claim backs up a story).
